## Objective

This notebook aims to:
1. Load preprocessing functions;
2. Import raw data;
3. Reshape the dataset into long format;
4. Export the final dataset for statistical analyses.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
source("../sources/questionnaire_preprocessing.R")
raw_data_1st_imp <- read_xlsx("../data/data_1st_imp.xlsx")

```

```{r}
data_imp <- organize_data(raw_data_1st_imp)
```

```{r}
# Quick checks
head(data_imp)
dim(data_imp)
colSums(is.na(data_imp)) # Check for missing values, 0 means no missing data
```

```{r}
write_csv(data_imp, "../data/data_imp.csv")
if (file.exists("../data/data_imp.csv")) {
  print("Data successfully exported to ../data/data_imp.csv")
} else {
  print("Error: Data export failed.")
}
```
